levels.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن عقيل

notes: «سمع جابرا» (rule 5) ends the first route; «قال سفيان وحدثنا محمد بن المنكدر، عن جابر» is a second isnad before the saying, carrying the same saying: a second group.
The second «سفيان» is written as «قال سفيان» and is not merged with Sufyan b. Uyayna of the first route.
The compiler's remarks after the saying (وفي الباب عن ...) are not chains.
